title: Spin, Magnetic Moments, and Anomalies
question: How does a stated spin-moment model predict magnetic response in an applied field?
summary: Calculate field-driven precession only after declaring the spin-moment model, field, state, environment, and applicable shielding or composite corrections. Keep model output separate from an identified measurement with uncertainty; measured or fitted magnetic factors do not by themselves validate a proposed geometric particle model.

caveats: A calculated response is model output, not an observation.
